senses.gloss: (b. h.) to stay over night, to take (night-) lodging; to be kept over night.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:3">Num. R. s. 12</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 91:1">Ps. XCI, 1</cite>) <he>שלָו שם לינות הרבה</he>, v. <cite ref="L00489"><he>לִינָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Psalms 91:1">Ib.</cite> <he>הקב״ה … נתאוה לָלוּן בצלינו</he> the Lord … is desirous to lodge under our shade (Tabernacle).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4">Snh. VI, 4</cite> <he>ואם לן</he> but if his body was allowed to hang over night.
<cite ref="Pesachim 42a">Pes. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>מים שלָנוּ</he> water which has been kept in vessels over night (misunderstood for ‘our water’, v. <cite ref="B00752"><he>בִּית</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Berakhot 18b:7">Ber. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>ולן בבית הקברות</he> and stayed over night in the burial ground; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 60:8">Gen. R. s. 60</cite>, distinction between <he>לָלִין</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 24:23">Gen. XXIV, 23</cite> and <he>לָלוּן</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 24:25">ib. 25</cite>, v. <cite ref="L00489"><he>לִינָה</he></cite>.]

B. Kam. 99ᵃ עובר משום (לא) בל תָּלִין transgresses the law which says, (Lev. XIX, 13) ‘thou shalt not &c.’; B. Mets. IX, 12 יש בו משום לא תלין וכ׳ the prohibition to keep the wages of the hired man over night applies to it; ib. 111ᵇ; a. fr.—Esp. to leave a corpse unburied over night.

<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:5">Snh. VI, 5</cite> <he>כל המֵלִין את וכ׳</he> whosoever postpones the burial of his dead transgresses a prohibitory law (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 21:23">Deut. XXI, 23</cite> in its general application); <he>הֵלִינוֹ לכבודו וכ׳</he> but if one kept him over night for his honor’s sake (to prepare a more honorable burial) &c.; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="E00579"><he>הֲלָנָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: , Nithpol. נִתְלוֹנֵן to seek shelter; to take refuge. Num. R. l. c. (ref. to Ps. l. c.) [read:] שדי תִּתְלוֹנֵן בצל שעשה לך וכ׳ Almighty, be pleased to lodge in the shade which Bezaleel has made for thee.
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 906:5">Yalk. Job 906</cite> <he>יש להם מנוס שׁיִתְלוֹנְנוּ מדינה וכ׳</he> have a place of refuge where to find shelter from the judgment of Gehenna; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 41:2">Yalk. Jud. 41</cite> <he>שינצלו</he>).
